def compute_mutual_info(x, y, bins=10):
    # Discretize continuous variables into bins
    x_binned = np.digitize(x, bins=np.linspace(np.min(x), np.max(x), bins))
    y_binned = np.digitize(y, bins=np.linspace(np.min(y), np.max(y), bins))
    
    # Create contingency table
    contingency = np.zeros((bins, bins))
    for xi, yi in zip(x_binned, y_binned):
        if xi < bins and yi < bins:  # Ensure indices are within bounds
            contingency[xi-1 if xi > 0 else 0][yi-1 if yi > 0 else 0] += 1
    
    # Calculate marginal probabilities
    total = np.sum(contingency)
    if total == 0:
